Distributors typically handle the physical distribution of products and provide services like inventory management, credit, and aftersales support.  
Agents usually don’t take ownership of goods, so they don’t offer inventory or credit in the same way.  
Merchants buy and sell goods but may not necessarily emphasize the distribution services described.  
Franchises operate under a branded business model but aren’t primarily defined by distributing products with those specific services.  

The description best matches **Distributors**.  

Final answer: (A)
